ranked.headline: Frozen single-cell foundation models repurposed for cross-modality and trajectory tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints reuse frozen single-cell foundation models for multiomics completion and RNA-ATAC alignment, alongside new trajectory evaluation metrics.

ranked.headline: Spatial niches and cell states resolved from spatial transcriptomic and chromatin data
ranked.summary: Spatial tools now test niche-dependent expression, domain boundaries, and cell-state versus cell-type identity in situ.

ranked.headline: Software tools automate design and assessment of hybrid capture and oligo pool reagents
ranked.summary: Integrated design, assessment and tool access within single packages now covers hybrid capture probes and DNA library construction.

ranked.headline: Matched-protocol benchmarks test pipeline choices over architectures in ADMET prediction
ranked.summary: Matched-budget and protocol-matched ADMET benchmarks now isolate acquisition policy, model family and representation choice as the variables under study.

ranked.headline: Sequence models predict chromatin accessibility and variant effects on gene regulation
ranked.summary: Single-molecule footprinting and cell-type-resolved sequence models now link DNA sequence and genotype to chromatin and expression readouts.

ranked.headline: LLM agents couple language reasoning to executable tools for omics and genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Agentic LLMs are moving from text generation to tool-invoking analysis, now evaluated on clinical genomics, scRNA-seq and spatial omics.

ranked.headline: Curated microbial reference resources organize genomes, plasmids and metagenomes
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair reusable microbial genome and metagenome resources with new workflows for symbiont, strain, and metabolic inference.

ranked.headline: Validating predicted omics layers inferred from histology and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints frame cross-modal omics prediction as a validation problem, testing whether inferred molecular layers match measured ground truth.

ranked.headline: Cell-type-resolved resources link single-cell and bulk omics to disease biology
ranked.summary: Recent database and tool releases encode cell-type and spatial context into methylation, copy-number, eQTL, and single-nucleus disease resources.

ranked.headline: Validation design governs whether predictive claims survive held-out testing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints evaluate predictions against held-out cohorts, source-context ranking, and identifiability checks rather than benchmark accuracy alone.

ranked.headline: Transcript-level tools refine isoform quantification and mapping ambiguity in RNA-seq
ranked.summary: Long-read and short-read RNA-seq now feed transcript-level tools benchmarked against established quantifiers and internal controls.

ranked.headline: Curated databases and workflows consolidate spatial transcriptomics datasets
ranked.summary: Large public spatial and single-cell collections now need harmonized access and reproducible workflows to be reused across platforms.

ranked.headline: Perturbation-response and regulatory models for inferring single-cell state dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple perturbation-response prediction and causal inference with explicit models of cell-state transitions and regulatory paths.

ranked.headline: Learned representations predict mutation, metabolite, and protein interaction outcomes
ranked.summary: Self-supervised and deep learning models now draw on ~50,000 tumors, MS/MS spectra, and deep mutational scans, pointing toward scalable multimodal integration.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks turn microscopy and spatial data into validated quantitative…
ranked.summary: Preprints and one published framework now package virtual staining, single-molecule, and spatial transcriptomics analyses into quantitative computational tools.

ranked.headline: Linking network topology to omics data in interactive web and Bioconductor tools
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints present web and Bioconductor infrastructure for visualizing multilayered biological networks alongside omics measurements.

ranked.headline: Somatic variant detection methods are being tested on pangenome, plant and mtDNA data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication benchmark somatic variant and mobile element calling across pangenome, plant, and human tissue datasets.

ranked.headline: Biomedical LLM agents are judged on evidence weighting, provenance, and error control
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and scaffolds now test whether agent outputs trace to biological evidence sources and recorded provenance, not open-ended generation.

ranked.headline: WGD subclones in non-WGD tumours reveal doubling beyond binary status
ranked.summary: Pan-cancer and single-cell analyses now move whole-genome doubling from binary tumour status toward clonal fraction and subclonal resolution.

ranked.headline: Auditable computational workflows for protein expression, structure search and recoding
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale purification, yield, structure-search and recoding studies now pair predictive models with explicit calibration or provenance checks.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and conditioned models guide DNA, RNA, protein, and antibody design
ranked.summary: Pretrained RNA, protein, and antibody priors are being paired with explicit conditioning for design and prediction tasks across recent preprints and papers.

ranked.headline: Classifiers assign microbial taxonomy from long amplicon and metagenomic reads
ranked.summary: Full-length PacBio 16S and ITS reads and DNA language models are now being benchmarked for species-level taxonomic assignment.

ranked.headline: Computational tools link structure, bioactivity and genomes to peptide and natural…
ranked.summary: Curated bioactivity databases and structure-based design tools now connect predicted chemistry with condition-resolved experimental data for peptide discovery.

ranked.headline: Curated databases tie biomolecular structures to experimental binding and specificity
ranked.summary: Recent releases of ARIEL, SAbDab2, and the TCR Motif Atlas add experimentally anchored affinity and benchmark-ready annotation to structural and specificity…

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale genomes link organelle metabolism and sex chromosome evolution
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published phylogenomic study resolve genome structure across algae, mosses, and a nitroplast-hosting haptophyte.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and accelerated tools reshape genomic inference from raw sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Deep models now operate on raw reads and pileups rather than aggregated summaries, while mapping and single-cell tools push runtime and memory limits.

ranked.headline: Deep models annotate subcompartments, predict TAD boundaries and enhance Hi-C contacts
ranked.summary: Recent Hi-C models pair compact architectures and pretrained foundation models to decode chromatin folding from contact matrices.

ranked.headline: Resources standardizing computational interpretation of diverse variant classes
ranked.summary: Recent resources extend variant interpretation to non-coding mtDNA positions and to structural and copy-number variation.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate bounded, provenance-tracked biology workflows
ranked.summary: Agentic and benchmark tooling now encodes domain structure into auditable workflows spanning drug screening, gene-level evidence, and protein design.

ranked.headline: Generative ensemble models conditioned on SAXS, cryo-EM, and DEER data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply experimental observables as constraints on generative models of protein conformational distributions.

ranked.headline: Coarse and mesoscale models link chromatin mechanics, cohesin, and helicase dynamics
ranked.summary: Coupled simulation and inference frameworks now recover hydration, cohesin turnover, and helicase unwinding mechanisms from structural and kinetic data.

ranked.headline: Molecular profiles linked to treatment response, adverse events and survival
ranked.summary: Single-cell and methylation data are being modeled against individual outcomes, from immune trajectories to childhood tumor survival.

ranked.headline: Organ-specific proteomic clocks and genetic maps resolve tissue-level variation
ranked.summary: Organ-resolved measurements now separate aging, cellular composition, and heritable adiposity within individual tissues.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models extract glioblastoma invasion parameters from imaging data
ranked.summary: Single time-point MRI and ex vivo imaging are being paired with mechanistic models to yield interpretable glioblastoma parameters.

ranked.headline: Graph pangenomes and simulation reveal structural variation drivers across genomes
ranked.summary: Graph pangenomes resolve structural variants across 1060 isolates while forward simulation infers transposable element turnover rates.

ranked.headline: Computational methods predict and validate RNA structure and RNA-ligand binding sites
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend sequence-based, deep-learning, and genome-scale tools to RNA structure, binding-site prediction, and cryoEM identification.

ranked.headline: Metabolic measures linked to genetic and clinical evidence in large human resources
ranked.summary: Large biobank metabolomics and transcriptome QTL resources now enable direct linkage of metabolic traits to genetic and disease evidence.

ranked.headline: Biological models are judged against explicit biological and measurement references
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test learned biological model outputs against explicit biological or measurement-level criteria.

ranked.headline: Mechanical and diffusive mechanisms in silico generate emergent tissue geometry
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple explicit physical mechanisms to emergent geometry, with connectivity and stress signals evolving during growth.

ranked.headline: Structural modelling and MD simulations link variants to protein structure and function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study couple structural modelling and MD simulations to pathogenic variant effects across several protein systems.
